Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Research Specialist (Sub-workflow) and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Document Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Append Audit Row (Google Sheets), Archive Row Snapshot, Load Previous Snapshot, Park in Dead-Letter Queue, Persist Deliverable to Google Sheets and pick the real documentId from the list.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "enrichment.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Receive Inbound Webhook" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Set the environment variables, or inline the values
behaviour.detail: This template reads $env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID. Environment variables are not exposed to expressions on n8n Cloud at all, and on self-hosted they are unset until you add them - in both cases the expression falls through to its literal fallback rather than erroring, so the call is made against a placeholder.
